inbox/welcome.title: GNC Terminal runs on your computer now
inbox/welcome.body: Prices refresh every 15 minutes on weekdays between 09:55 and 23:15 Istanbul time (Yahoo Finance batch quotes: BIST about 15 minutes delayed, US stocks and FX near real time); the full 1-year history, company profiles and picks are rebuilt nightly at 00:30. TEFAS funds update once a day, TCMB EVDS macro data at 10:15 and 16:45, broker research three times a day, IPOs twice a day and regulator news every 6 hours. The first start builds the whole universe (S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, BIST all shares, BYFs, TEFAS funds), which takes 10–20 minutes; the progress bar shows how far it is. Three minutes after start-up, and nightly at 01:30, a backfill job adds ten years of daily history and the point-in-time fundamentals (SEC EDGAR for US stocks, İş Yatırım / KAP for BIST) — it takes a few hours on the first night and resumes where it stopped; Settings › Data health shows the progress.
